slides.title: A true story
slides.transcript: [warmly] Loza the Cat. A true story, for Noah. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] A shy little cat, and a family who waited for her.

slides.title: A Kitten at the Shelter
slides.transcript: [warmly] A Kitten at the Shelter. <break time="0.4s" /> Once, at a shelter in San Diego, there was a tiny white kitten with one blue eye and one green eye. Mama and Gedo saw her, and took her home. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Welcome home, Loza.

slides.title: Where Did Loza Go?
slides.transcript: [warmly] Where Did Loza Go? <break time="0.4s" /> But Loza was shy — very, very shy. She hid under the bed. She hid behind the sofa. She hid in the cupboard. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Loza? Where are you?

slides.title: Mama Said No
slides.transcript: [warmly] Mama Said No. <break time="0.4s" /> Loza hid so much that everyone wondered if she would be happier somewhere else. But Mama said, “No. She is ours. She just needs time.” <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Loza stays.

slides.title: Little by Little
slides.transcript: [warmly] Little by Little. <break time="0.4s" /> Little by little, Loza came out. One paw. Then two. Then one sunny morning she sat in the window, as if she had always lived there. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Hello, home.

slides.title: Mama Married Baba
slides.transcript: [warmly] Mama Married Baba. <break time="0.4s" /> Then one happy day, Mama married Baba Ahmed, and Loza had a bigger family. She sniffed Baba's shoes all over, and decided he could stay. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Hello, Baba!

slides.title: And Then Noah
slides.transcript: [warmly] And Then Noah. <break time="0.4s" /> Then one day a very small baby came home. Loza crept close, sniffed his tiny toes, and lay down beside him to keep watch. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Hello, Noah.

slides.title: Loza and Noah Play
slides.transcript: [warmly] Loza and Noah Play. <break time="0.4s" /> Now Loza and Noah play every day. She chases the yarn. She hides in her cosy cave. Where is Loza? <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peekaboo!

slides.title: Just the Right Spot
slides.transcript: [warmly] Just the Right Spot. <break time="0.4s" /> Now Loza is the sweetest cat. But pet her one second too long, or one inch away from her favourite spot, and… <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Chomp! Not there!

slides.title: Two Different Eyes
slides.transcript: [warmly] Two Different Eyes. <break time="0.4s" /> Loza has one blue eye, blue like the sea in San Diego. And one green eye, green like the grass in the park. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] One blue, one green.

slides.title: Goodnight, Loza
slides.transcript: [softly] Goodnight, Loza. <break time="0.4s" /> Goodnight Baba. Goodnight Mama. Goodnight Loza, curled up at the end of the bed. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Noah.
